backend_router.note: router/failover.py implements this. FailoverRouter.dispatch_next() reads todo_queue above, finds the first entry with status=pending and all depends_on marked done, and dispatches it to whichever backend's is_available() returns true first, in priority order below.

handoff_protocol.rule: Any model resuming this build reads ARK-STATE.json first, finds the lowest-numbered todo_queue entry with status=pending and satisfied depends_on, executes it, then updates that entry's status plus updated_at/updated_by before stopping. Never merge the working branch's PR to main autonomously -- that is a human decision (see T5.1).
